::: {style="text-align:center"}
## The World's Tallest Tree
:::

![](https://irp.cdn-website.com/4ef20bc3/dms3rep/multi/IMG_0587.jpg)

###### **Pictured above is the world's tallest tree, *Sequoia sepervirens*. It is only found on the western coast of the U.S. in very small populations. Conservation of its limited habitat is extremely critical.**

### Sequoia Fun Facts:

- The bark of a Sequoia tree is thick with a spongy texture containing protective compounds that allows the tree to be very fire resistant. Since the western coast of the U.S. has a rich history of fire sweeping the landscape, this characteristic has contributed to the tree's persistence.

- Some famous Sequoias in the U.S. include General Sherman (Sequoia National Park), General Grant (King's Canyon National Park), and Grizzly Giant (Yosemite National Park).
